jobs.title: Product Designer
jobs.description:
Description
Artlist is a leading creative technology company on a mission to empower creators and brands to bring their vision to life with video. Offering cutting-edge AI tools and models for image, video, and voiceover creation, alongside high-quality creative assets and powerful editing tools, Artlist enables creators to stay on trend, and achieve their creative goals. Trusted by over 30 million creators worldwide and top brands including Google, Amazon, Microsoft, and Versace, Artlist provides a seamless, subscription-based platform with a global license, giving creators everything they need to produce professional video content efficiently. For more information, visit artlist.io .
 We're looking for a Product Designer to help shape what B2B creative tools look like in the AI era.
 Artlist is an AI-native company - Claude Code, Figma Make, and vibe coding are part of how our product team works every day. We're looking for a designer who works the same way: fluent in AI-powered tools, rigorous about design systems, and experienced designing complex B2B products.
 What you'll do 
 • Own product design end-to-end - discovery, flows, prototyping, interaction design, and high-fidelity UI.
• Use Claude Code, Figma Make, and vibe coding as active parts of your workflow.
• Build, maintain, and evolve a scalable design system - component architecture, token structure, and documentation.
• Design AI-powered creative experiences for enterprise teams and professional creators.
• Shape roadmap decisions alongside product and engineering, and use research and data to validate what we ship.
Requirements
• 4+ years designing digital products or creative tools - B2B SaaS experience is an advantage.
• Hands-on fluency with Claude Code, Figma Make, and vibe coding.
• Deep design system expertise - component architecture, token structure, documentation, and governance at scale.
• Strong product thinking with experience designing complex, multi-step workflows.
• Excellent visual and interaction design craft - clarity, hierarchy, and polish.
• Experience with AI generation tools (image, video, or content) - an advantage.
• A portfolio that demonstrates both strong thinking and strong execution.

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer
jobs.description:
Description
At Classiq Technologies, we’re shaping the future of quantum computing.
 Our mission is to make quantum computing practical and impactful by bridging the gap between hardware and real-world applications. Our platform enables developers and enterprises to design, optimize, and deploy quantum algorithms at scale, automating complex processes and supporting teams from beginners to experts across diverse architectures.
 Classiq is trusted by Fortune 500 leaders and global governments. We accelerate the quantum era with a platform that transforms bold quantum ideas into working applications.
 We're looking for a Product Designer with exceptional UI skills and a real eye for visual craft to help shape the look and feel of Classiq’s quantum developer platform. This role is for someone who can bring a distinctive visual voice to a deeply technical product.
 You'll own the visual and interaction design of key parts of the platform, working closely with other designers, product managers, and engineers. This is a hands-on, high-impact role with few predefined roadmaps, so we're looking for someone with a strong point of view and the range to define things rather than just execute them. We care about the originality and strength of your work; a standout portfolio is essential.
 What you'll do 
 • Design visual language for Classiq's SaaS platform and quantum developer tools, with a strong emphasis on visual quality and polish
• Design UI and UX for complex, technical workflows
• Bring illustration and graphic design into the product, from iconography to visual systems that make complex quantum concepts feel intuitive
• Translate abstract, technical, and quantum ideas into clear and visually compelling experiences
• Help raise the visual bar and evolve our design language
• Contribute creatively and strategically in an environment with few predefined roadmaps
 Who you are 
 • 5+ Years of product design experience
• A portfolio that stands out visually, projects showing craft, a strong point of view, and distinctive UI and UX
• Experience in visually rich domains (game design, data visualizations, developer/design/music tools, or similarly demanding visual work) is an advantage
• Shipped UI/UX/product work you can point to. Please include links to live projects
• Proficient in Figma
• Fluent in English
• Curiosity about technical, scientific, and complex products: you don't need a quantum background, but you should be genuinely interested in how systems work
 Bonus points 
 • Excellent graphic design skills, strong illustration skills are a plus
• Experience with scientific projects is a plus

jobs.title: Product Designer
jobs.description:
Description
Trullion is transforming the accounting world with an AI-powered platform built for accountants and auditors. Our technology automates complex financial workflows, boosts efficiency, reduces costly errors, and fosters real collaboration. Founded in 2019, Trullion is on a mission to make accounting and audit technology people truly love, driving a more efficient, transparent, and human-oriented industry. From rapid onboarding to a seamless managed service model, we deliver a customer-first experience at every step.
 Headquartered in New York, with offices in Tel Aviv and London, we are backed by top investors, including Aleph, Third Point Ventures, Greycroft, StepStone Group, as well as leading global CFOs and accounting firms.
 As Trullion continues to scale, we’re seeking a Product Designer to help define the next generation of AI-powered accounting experiences - someone who thrives on solving complex product challenges, owns end-to-end design and is excited to shape a category-leading product used by finance and audit teams worldwide.
 We're building a platform where AI agents do real accounting and audit work alongside people. We're looking for a Mid-Senior Product Designer who thrives on solving complex product challenges, brings strong visual craft, works fluently inside an established design system and helps it grow.
Responsibilities
• Design end-to-end experiences for the Office of the CFO, where finance leaders and teams work with AI and agents on high-stakes workflows. 
• Work on the platform and infrastructure layer: shared experience patterns, frameworks, and foundations that let new capabilities feel like one coherent product, not separate features. 
• Contribute to Trullion’s design system: extend components, tokens, and variables, and keep them consistent and scalable as the product grows. 
• Lead the full design cycle, from research and flows to pixel-perfect UX/UI across all states and scenarios. 
• Raise the visual bar of the product with a modern, refined UI. 
• Collaborate closely with Product and R&D on design consistency and execution quality. 
• Create high-fidelity mockups and prototypes for testing, iteration, and customer validation. 
• Present concepts to stakeholders and advocate for decisions rooted in data, research, and user needs.
Requirements
• 4+ years of experience in product design (mid-senior to senior), ideally in a product-led SaaS company. 
• Experience designing for complex B2B SaaS, ideally finance or other data-heavy products. 
• Experience in companies with an established design system. Proven experience contributing to one. 
• Solid knowledge of design tokens and variables: structure, naming, modes/theming, and how they map to code. 
• Strong visual skills and a good understanding of modern UI. 
• Genuine interest in designing for AI agents and in generative UI. 
• Strong portfolio showing flows, systems thinking, and UI execution. 
• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, and the ability to work independently and collaboratively. 
• Experience prototyping with AI tools. 
• Hands-on experience designing AI, agent-based, or generative UI experiences.
About us
We embrace our core values in everything we do: 
 • Think BIG. We are ambitious, proactive, and we love challenging the status quo. 
• Live by Truth. We uphold the highest standards of accuracy and accountability. 
• On Your Side. We’re on this journey together, committed to empowering each other to succeed. 
• Committed. To execution, delivery, and excellence.

jobs.title: Brand and Web Designer - DesignDev team
Senior Product Designer
jobs.location: Ramat Gan, Israel, Ramat Gan, IL
jobs.description:
Description
Coralogix is a modern, full-stack observability platform transforming how businesses process and understand their data. Our unique architecture powers in-stream analytics without reliance on expensive indexing or hot storage. We specialize in comprehensive monitoring of logs, metrics, traces, and security events - with features such as APM, RUM, SIEM, and Kubernetes monitoring — all enhancing operational efficiency and reducing observability spend by up to 70%.
 We're a well-established startup, post-Series F, with paying customers and sales across the globe. Our design studio is mature, with multiple teams already in place - and we're looking for an exceptional, experienced Senior Product Designer to help us move the needle in a fast-paced, growing environment.
 Why this role is different 
 This isn't a hand-off-the-mockups role. We give designers real ownership of the product:
 • End-to-end ownership. Every designer on the team owns projects from early wireframes to mockups to live, shipped features. You own the outcome, not just the artboard.
• We're an AI-native design team. AI is woven into how we work day-to-day - Claude Code included - and the company actively supports and invests in giving us the best tools to do it well.
• Designers ship to production. Our team has access to the company codebase and pushes UI code to production directly. This isn't about replacing engineers - it's about design owning the quality of the UI, working hand-in-hand with R&D. You'll be accountable for the product experience, not just advocating for it.
 You'll design work tools that help developers, DevOps, and R&D teams manage complex software - turning dense, technical, data-heavy problems into clear, elegant experiences for technical users.
 Responsibilities 
 • Design end-to-end user experiences, from research and wireframes to high-fidelity mockups to final implemented live features.
• Validate your work through user research - interviews, usability testing, and analysis of product data - and iterate quickly based on what you learn.
• Ground your design decisions in evidence - product data, user research, and feedback - and help define the success metrics that connect your work to user needs and business goals.
• Work closely with R&D and product teams to bring these experiences to life.
• Take ownership of UI quality in production, including shipping front-end changes directly (with AI tooling and our design system).
• Contribute to, manage, and refine our product style guide and design system.
• Make complex technical solutions clear and usable for a technical audience.
Requirements
• 4+ years designing a complex system or platform.
• Experience designing for data-heavy products - comfortable making dense data and complex information clear and usable.
• Comfortable leading user research - interviews and usability testing - and translating findings into clear design decisions.
• Strong interaction and visual design skills with high attention to detail.
• Experience collaborating closely with R&D.
• Expertise with prototyping and design tools (Figma, Figma Make, Claude Code, v0, or similar tools).
• A solid understanding of CSS and HTML, and working knowledge of git and vibe coding.
• Experience working with product data and research tools (Google Analytics, Mixpanel, Amplitude, Hotjar, Maze, or similar tools).
• Strong systems thinking and a grasp of component-based design patterns.
• Ability to adapt, switch gears, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced team.
• Strong English, and excellent communication, presentation, and organizational skills.
• A portfolio that showcases relevant, complex work.
• Passion for crafting exceptional UX and a problem-solver's mindset - able to research and understand hard problems and deliver simple, elegant solutions.
 Nice to have 
 We can teach the right person our AI workflow - but it's a real plus if you already bring:
 • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted workflows or tools like Claude Code.
• Comfort with git and basic development workflows.
• A University degree in Design.
 Cultural Fit 
 We’re seeking candidates who are hungry, humble, and smart. Coralogix fosters a culture of innovation and continuous learning, where team members are encouraged to challenge the status quo and contribute to our shared mission. If you thrive in dynamic environments and are eager to shape the future of observability solutions, we’d love to hear from you.
 Coralogix is an equal opportunity employer and encourages applicants from all backgrounds to apply.

jobs.title: Product Designer- Maternity Leave Cover
jobs.description:
Realize your potential by joining the leading performance-driven advertising company and a proud Dun’s 100 Best High-Tech Companies to Work For in Israel!
 As a Product Designer on the Taboola News team in our Tel Aviv office, you'll design the mobile experiences millions of people use every day to discover content on devices from the world's leading OEMs and carriers. As a B2B2C product, we design for two goals: an experience people value and come back to, and revenue results for our OEM partners. You'll own a product area end to end, working closely with Product, Engineering, Data, and OEM partners. This is a fixed-term maternity leave cover of 9 months.
 To thrive in this role, you'll need: 
• 3+ years of experience in product design, with a portfolio of B2C mobile products that drive engagement and retention.
• Hands-on craft from early concepts to pixel-perfect delivery, using AI tools to move faster from concept to prototype.
• Experience with UX research, conversion funnels, and user journeys, using qualitative and quantitative data to drive design decisions.
• Product thinking - you separate what matters from what doesn't, weigh design choices against user and business impact, and believe (as we do) that a good designer is 30% PM.

 Bonus points if you have: 
• Experience designing for OEM, carrier, or device-level surfaces such as lock screens, widgets, or home-screen feeds.

 How you'll make an impact: 
• Own the design of a Taboola News product area, working closely with its PMs, R&D, and business teams.

• Design core flows end to end - concepts, prototypes, and designs ready for development - within the Taboola News design system.
• Run user research and usability tests, and turn the findings into design decisions.
• Follow features after launch and iterate based on qualitative and quantitative data.

 Why Taboola? 
 If you ask Taboolars what they love about working here, they'll tell you that they've been empowered to realize their full potential while growing and learning from and with smart and talented people. They'll also share more about:

 Ready to realize your potential? 
 Taboola is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity in all forms. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and believe such an environment is critical for success. Employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.
 Learn more about #TaboolaLife on LinkedIn , Facebook , Instagram , X, YouTube , & the Taboola Life Blog .
 About Taboola 
 Taboola empowers businesses to grow through performance advertising technology that goes beyond search and social and delivers measurable outcomes at scale.
 Taboola works with thousands of businesses who advertise directly on Realize, Taboola's powerful ad platform, reaching approximately 600M daily active users across some of the best publishers in the world. Publishers like NBC News, Yahoo, and OEMs such as Samsung, Xiaomi and others use Taboola's technology to grow audience and revenue, enabling Realize to offer unique data, specialized algorithms, and unmatched scale.

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer
jobs.description:
Description
Guardio is one of the fastest-growing companies in consumer cybersecurity - we’ve doubled revenue four years running, passed $150 million in ARR, and now protect over a million people, at a moment when AI has made scams more convincing than ever.
 AI has democratized cybercrime: scams that once required sophisticated hacking teams are now cheap, personalized, and everywhere.
 Traditional security wasn’t built for this - so we’re building it, protection that sees the person, connects all the dots - and stop attacks and scams wherever vector they come from.
 And honestly, we all feel here - it’s just the beginning!
 So, what’s the job? 
 We are looking for an impact-driven Senior Product Designer with high-level UX/UI craft and a passion for building seamless user journeys.
 You’ll be an integral part of a squad that moves fast, leverages modern tools to iterate rapidly, and focuses on pushing the company forward through continuous experimentation and measurable, high-scale results.
 You will 
 • Lead projects independently while collaborating effectively within a squad, managing the creative process from concept to final execution.
• Work closely with your squad in a fast-paced environment, delivering impactful assets quickly and directly contributing to business growth and success.
• Make data-driven design decisions, using KPIs and testing to inform creative solutions, optimize performance, and drive product improvements.
• Partner closely with Product Managers, preparing designs for development, ensuring smooth handoff and implementation.
• Bring broad and versatile product design capabilities, with strong UI/UX expertise and sharp attention to detail.
• Be part of Guardio’s Design team, which includes Product Designers and Brand Marketing Designers. As well as your work, you’ll be involved in creating methodologies and best practices for the Design team.
 Sounds great! Am I the right fit? 
 You have a great chance of being that person if you check as many of these as possible: 
 • 5+ years of experience as a UX/UI Product Designer (B2C or SaaS) within a high-performing product team.
• Strong communicator who thrives when collaborating across different disciplines and teams.
• Highly proficient in Figma.
• AI-native mindset - Must - you actively use AI tools (generative image, LLMs, design-to-code) as core workflow accelerators, know how to write effective prompts, and apply strong editorial judgment to curate outputs. You have opinions about what good AI-powered UX looks like and have designed features that involve AI or automated decision-making.

• Strategic thinker who knows how to see the big picture, plan effectively, and multi-task in a fast-paced environment.

jobs.description:

Through deep integrations across the eCommerce ecosystem and the trust of over 30,000 global brands, Yotpo delivers seamless omnichannel experiences that increase conversion, strengthen customer relationships, and drive profitable, long-term growth.
 We’re looking for an experienced Product Designer to join our Discover team . In this role, you’ll lead end-to-end design for complex B2B2C eCommerce products, embrace AI-native workflows, and shape user experiences that help drive product strategy.
 With teams spread across the globe - from the US and Canada to the UK, Israel, Bulgaria, and Australia - we're growing fast. Our main mission? Delivering cutting-edge technology that sets new standards in the industry.
 Sounds exciting? Then read on, because we’re looking for curious professional talents to be a part of building the future of the e-commerce industry.
 As part of our Discover Product team , you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping the future of our discovery experience by creating intuitive, thoughtful, data-informed, and customer-centric designs that integrate AI behaviors, leverage AI-native workflows, and deliver real value.
 What you'll do 
• Lead end-to-end product design for complex B2B2C experiences in the Discover domain, from problem definition through execution.

 What you'll bring 
 Design craft & AI-native process: Strong portfolio showcasing end-to-end product design, UX/UI excellence, and experience designing AI behaviors or using AI-native workflows and Git-based developer integration to prototype and iterate quickly.
 Experience: 5+ years of experience designing digital products in fast-paced B2B2C or B2B SaaS environments. Experience in eCommerce is highly preferred.
 Collaboration: Proven track record partnering closely with Product Managers and Engineering leads to balance user needs, technical constraints, and business goals.

 If you don’t meet 100% of the qualifications outlined above, that’s okay! We hire people, not checklists. 
 If you’re eager to learn, passionate, and like-minded, we’d love to hear from you. 
 Help us be the best version of Yotpo by building something great together!

jobs.title: Product Designer - Maternity Leave
jobs.description:
At Similarweb, we are a leading AI-powered digital intelligence company. By providing AI with massive scale data on actual online behaviors - including searches, site visits, and transactions - we deliver actionable market insights. Today, over half of the Fortune 500 trust our platform to drive their strategic next steps.
 In 2021, we went public on the New York Stock Exchange and continued reaching new heights! Work alongside Similarwebbers who are bright, curious, practical, and good people.
 We are looking for a curious and hands-on Product Designer to join our design team as a maternity leave replacement. You'll take your product areas from A to Z, working closely with product managers and engineers to turn complex problems into intuitive designs that serve both user needs and business goals.
 You will join a centralized design team reporting to a practicing product designer, ensuring collaborative feedback and support.
 This is not the same job it was two years ago. AI is changing what we build - our product is moving toward AI agents and AI-driven insights on top of the most comprehensive digital dataset in the world. It's changing how we build it - research, prototyping, design systems, and handoff to engineering all work differently now. And it's changing the tools we use, including the ones we're building for ourselves. The field is reshaping as we go and we adjust with it. We're looking for someone who finds that exciting rather than exhausting.
 So, what will you be doing all day? 
 Your role as a Product Designer at Similarweb means your daily responsibilities may include:
• Owning meaningful areas of our product - from research and ideation through user flows, prototyping, testing, microcopy, and all the way to launch.
• Turning dense, complex data into experiences people can actually read, trust, and act on.
• Designing AI-powered experiences: agentic flows, prompt- and conversation-driven interfaces, and AI-generated insights. That means designing for the hard parts too - non-deterministic outputs, trust and explainability, keeping a human in the loop, and what the experience looks like when the model gets it wrong.
• Using AI throughout your own process to get from idea to something real, fast - prototyping working flows instead of static screens, exploring more directions before committing, and putting real interactions in front of stakeholders and users early.
• Building, not only specifying. Some of what you design you'll take considerably further yourself, using AI tools to produce working features that engineering reviews before release. Knowing where that line sits - what's ready to ship and what needs a second pair of eyes - is part of the craft now.
• Maintaining and evolving our design system - components, variables, tokens, patterns, and guidelines - so quality and consistency hold as the product scales, and so anyone building against it (designer, engineer, or AI tool) ends up with something that looks and behaves like Similarweb.
• Using quantitative and qualitative data tools to research, track, and measure design flows.
• Communicating with stakeholders, including executives, on design decisions, progress, and outcomes.
• Bringing back what you learn. New tools, new workflows, better ways of working - we test them, and we adopt what works.
 This is the perfect job for someone with: 
• 3+ years of experience in product design , with a proven track record of delivering digital SaaS products .
• Strong data visualization instincts - you're at home in dense analytical interfaces: time series, benchmarks, funnels, and tables people actually use.
• A strong portfolio that demonstrates your design skills, process, and impact on business objectives .
• Hands-on experience working with AI as part of your day-to-day design practice - prototyping, exploration, research, or production work. We care much more about how you actually use it than about which tools you name.
• Enough technical literacy to build, not just hand off. You don't need to be an engineer, but you should be able to take a design further than a Figma file with AI tools, read what comes back, and tell good output from output that only looks good.
• Design systems experience - you're fluent in Figma libraries (components, variants, variables, tokens) and know how to keep design and code in sync with engineers. Having built one is a plus, not a requirement.
• Excellent communication skills - ability to present your designs and sell your solutions to various stakeholders.
• Comfort with ambiguity, and enough independence to be the only designer on a problem - setting your own bar, making the call, and knowing when to pull other people in. Ways of working here change often, and we want someone who helps shape that rather than waits for it to settle.
 Advantages: 
• Experience designing AI-native features - agents, copilots, chat, or generative interfaces - a significant advantage.
• Experience on complex SaaS or analytics platforms.
• Experience writing structured context files for AI tools (such as design.md, AGENTS.md, or custom prompt rules) so both people and AI models can follow them.
• Experience designing products for digital marketers, or in competitive intelligence, e-commerce, web analytics, or the mobile app ecosystem.
 **At Similarweb, collaborating with our colleagues in the office creates a more connected, unified culture. Our best work is a product of our face-to-face collaboration, with the ability to work partially from home.**
 Why you’ll love being a Similarwebber: 
 Manage data at scale. You'll design for data sets most designers never get near, and the best companies in the world will use what you ship to make real decisions.
 Lead the AI era. You'll build with AI technology at a company engineered for the future - and in a design team actively working out what this craft becomes next, rather than waiting to be told.
 Own your projects. The trust, autonomy and freedom to do your best

jobs.title: Product Designer
jobs.description:
Lumana helps organizations turn video into action. Our AI video security platform helps customers improve safety, strengthen security, and respond faster when it matters most.

Founded in 2021 and backed by leading Silicon Valley investors, we’re growing quickly. Here, you’ll think big, move fast, and own work that has a visible impact.





Description

This Product Designer enjoys solving complex problems and wants meaningful ownership. You’ll design experiences across our web and mobile products, working closely with product managers, engineers, and our CEO.

Your access to leadership is part of the work. The CEO will look to you for design recommendations, ask questions, and challenge your thinking. You’ll need to explain your choices, raise concerns, and suggest a better approach when you see one.

You don’t need every answer or years of executive-facing experience. You do need curiosity, sound reasoning, and the willingness to contribute your own perspective—even when the person across the table is the CEO.

Please include your portfolio with your application. We’re interested in how you think as well as what you design.



Location

Hybrid: Based in Caesarea, Israel with 2 days a week working from home.



Why this role is exciting

 - Direct influence: Discuss problems and design decisions with the people shaping the product, including our CEO.

 - Meaningful ownership: Take individual projects from an initial problem through exploration, design, and implementation.

 - Interesting complexity: Make technical workflows easier to understand across cameras, locations, filters, onboarding, and other connected parts of the platform.

 - Visible impact: Work on improvements that change how customers use the product. For example, our bulk camera onboarding flow helped users add multiple cameras in one process.

 - Room to grow: Learn through close collaboration with Product and Engineering, with support from the CTO on technical questions and broader work processes.

 - Freedom to explore: Experiment with different approaches, workflows, and AI tools to improve your work.

What you’ll do

 - Turn high-level product requests into clear problems, asking questions before jumping into solutions.

 - Create user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and polished interfaces for web and mobile.

 - Consider how a change affects the wider product, including related workflows, navigation, and existing patterns.

 - Gather insight from product managers, engineers, Solutions Engineers, and other colleagues close to customer needs.

 - Present your recommendations to teammates and leadership, explaining your reasoning and the trade-offs.

 - Constructively challenge assumptions—including leadership’s—when you see a usability issue or a stronger alternative. Bring examples, evidence, or a proposed solution.

 - Test and refine designs using feedback, usability testing, and product insights.

 - Collaborate with engineers through handoff and implementation to help ensure the experience works as intended.

 - Contribute to our design system and maintain consistency across the product.

 - Balance thoughtful design with timely delivery as priorities evolve.

What you’ll bring

 - Approximately 5 years of product or UX/UI design experience, with a portfolio showing relevant work. We’re open to different experience levels when the work demonstrates strong potential.

 - A portfolio that explains the problem, your contribution, the options you considered, and why you chose your approach.

 - Strong foundations in interaction design, visual hierarchy, and usability.

 - Proficiency in Figma, including components and interactive prototypes.

 - Interest in technical products and the patience to understand how interconnected systems work.

 - Clear communication: you can explain a recommendation, ask for clarification, and respectfully disagree.

 - Openness to feedback and the ability to revise your thinking when new information changes the picture.

 - The ability to manage your tasks, surface blockers, and adapt when priorities shift.

Helpful, but not required

 - Experience with B2B software, dashboards, or other complex applications.

 - Experience collaborating with engineers on a shipped product.

 - Familiarity with user research, usability testing, or design systems.

 - Understanding of front-end implementation constraints.

 - Experience using AI tools in your design workflow.

 - Exposure to security technology, video, analytics, or computer vision.

What working here is like

 - We’re a small team building a complex product quickly. Some assignments are focused improvements; others require creating something new. You may manage several tasks at once and switch direction as priorities change.

 - Direct collaboration with leadership is required. This role will suit someone who wants to build confidence through preparation, thoughtful discussion, and hands-on work. We value designers who can support their recommendations, listen carefully, and help the team move forward once a decision is made.

 - If you enjoy learning, working through ambiguity, and seeing your ideas become part of a real product, there’s a lot to grow into here.



Our interview process

 - 30-minute conversation with Talent

 - 45-minute conversation with peers (Design & Product Management) 

 - Take-home assignment designed to take approximately three hours

 - 45-minute panel review with representatives from Design, Product, and Engineering leadership

 - 30-minute conversation with HR
   
   

What we offer

 - Equity in a fast growing start-up

 - Monthly meal allowance provided through 10bis

 - Travel reimbursement in accordance with Israeli law

 - Generous paid vacation, including carryover flexibility

 - Paid sick leave from day one

 - Keren Hishtalmut (study fund) with employer contributions

 - Company-provided laptop and a home-office setup allowance for new employees

 

Equal Opportunity: Lumana considers applicants

jobs.title: Staff Product Designer
jobs.description:
We're looking for a Staff Product Designer to help shape the future of how we design at Lemonade — not just by doing great work, but by raising the bar for everyone around you.

This role sits within our Product Design team, based in Tel Aviv. You'll take on the broadest, most complex design challenges we have — owning them end-to-end, driving decisions across teams and disciplines, and influencing how we think about product and design at a company level.

jobs.description:
About the Role
Houzz is looking for a cross-platform Product Designer with a growth mindset -- someone who wants to have an immediate impact on a great product. We are creative, curious, customer focused and passionate about solving problems. We iterate fast, design with data and collaborate closely with multiple teams.

What You’ll Do
• Design scalable concepts -- We design for many platforms and content types. We drive design ideas from early business needs, through rough concepts, to final, pixel-perfect implementation.
• Show attention to details on all levels -- Our work doesn't begin or end with pixels. We are constantly brainstorming new ideas and concepts while optimizing our current experiences.
• Stay on brand, until you can’t -- We know how to work within a design system while recognizing opportunities to draw outside the lines and improve our design language.
• Be a team player -- We don’t design in a bubble and everyone has a voice in our projects. In order to produce the best possible experience for our users all of our teams work together and provide feedback to each other. We collaborate with engineering, product and data analytics teams to build the best user experience.
At a Minimum, We'd Like You to Have
• You’ve shipped products -- Your portfolio is filled with product design that shows how you solved specific problems to meet users needs.
• A deep understanding of the problem you're solving -- You create intuitive experiences while considering diverse business requirements and technical complexities.
• Excellent communication skills -- You can effectively communicate your design rationale both verbally and visually.
• An understanding of trends in product design -- Including interaction patterns for web and mobile.
• Intelligence and self-motivation -- We’re looking for smart, motivated self-starters who can learn quickly.
• A collaborative mentality -- Desire to help and mentor other designers.
• Adaptability and flexibility -- Comfortable working in an ever-changing, fast-paced and cross time-zone environment.
Ideally, You'll Also Have
• A growth mindset -- You’re eager to learn, open to feedback, and excited to develop your skills on the job.
• Interest in design systems -- You’re curious about how components and guidelines create consistency at scale.
• Analytical curiosity -- You’re interested in how design decisions impact user behavior and product outcomes.
• Exposure to user research -- You’ve participated in user interviews or usability tests and used insights to improve your designs.
